queries.text: INSERT INTO customers (name, email, vip, preferred_method, metadata) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
queries.name: CreateCustomer

queries.text: SELECT id, name, email, vip, preferred_method, metadata, created_at FROM customers WHERE id = ?
queries.name: GetCustomer

queries.text: SELECT id, name, email, vip, preferred_method, metadata, created_at FROM customers WHERE name = ?
queries.name: FindCustomerByName
comments: Names are not unique: more than one match is an error, never a guess.

queries.text:
SELECT id, name FROM customers
WHERE (name LIKE ? OR email LIKE ?) AND name NOT LIKE '%:test%'
ORDER BY name
queries.name: SearchCustomers
comments: A name or email matching the pattern, but no test account: `%` and `:` stay literal.

queries.text: SELECT id, name, email, vip, preferred_method, metadata, created_at FROM customers WHERE id IN (/*SLICE:ids*/?) ORDER BY id
queries.name: ListCustomersByIds

queries.text:
INSERT INTO invoices (customer_id, number, issued_on, notes, attachment, pay_within)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
queries.name: CreateInvoice

queries.text: SELECT id, customer_id, number, status, total, issued_on, notes, attachment, pay_within, created_at FROM invoices WHERE id = ?
queries.name: GetInvoice

queries.text: SELECT status FROM invoices WHERE id = ?
queries.name: GetInvoiceStatus

queries.text:
SELECT invoices.id, invoices.customer_id, invoices.number, invoices.status, invoices.total, invoices.issued_on, invoices.notes, invoices.attachment, invoices.pay_within, invoices.created_at, customers.id, customers.name, customers.email, customers.vip, customers.preferred_method, customers.metadata, customers.created_at
FROM invoices JOIN customers ON customers.id = invoices.customer_id
WHERE invoices.id = ?
queries.name: GetInvoiceWithCustomer

queries.text:
SELECT id, customer_id, number, status, total, issued_on, notes, attachment, pay_within, created_at FROM invoices
WHERE status IN (/*SLICE:statuses*/?) AND customer_id = ?
ORDER BY number
queries.name: ListInvoicesByStatus

queries.text: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS SIGNED) AS invoice_count FROM invoices WHERE customer_id = ?
queries.name: CountInvoices

queries.text: UPDATE invoices SET status = 'issued', issued_on = ? WHERE id = ? AND status = 'draft'
queries.name: IssueInvoice

queries.text: INSERT INTO line_items (invoice_id, position, description, quantity, unit_price) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
queries.name: AddLineItems

queries.text: SELECT invoice_id, position, description, quantity, unit_price FROM line_items WHERE invoice_id = ? ORDER BY position
queries.name: ListLineItems

queries.text:
UPDATE invoices
SET total = (SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(quantity * unit_price), 0) AS DECIMAL(12, 2)) FROM line_items WHERE invoice_id = ?)
WHERE id = ?
queries.name: RecalculateTotal

queries.text: DELETE FROM invoices WHERE customer_id = ? AND status = 'draft'
queries.name: DeleteDraftInvoices
